entries.title: The Studio, a bigger card editor and a fix for the loading screen
entries.summary: Commands and events now have their own Studio page with a big zoomable canvas and many more blocks.
items: 🧩 New Studio page: drag blocks anywhere, zoom in and out, search blocks, 20+ new blocks, and new events (keyword, boost, voice join, role gained).
🖼️ The card builder lets you drag, resize, rotate and crop images and shapes.
☺ New emoji button next to message boxes: pick a Rex emoji and its text code is added for you.
🔒 Options your plan does not include are hidden instead of cluttering the page.
🎁 Ticket buttons can now be a "Giveaway prize claim" that finds the prize someone won and opens the claim ticket.
🔤 Crisper small icons (thicker lines on the circle-free set).
🔽 Pop-up forms in Discord now use real channel, role and member pickers instead of pasted IDs.
fixes: 🛠️ The dashboard no longer gets stuck on "loading". If something goes wrong it now says so.
📖 Floating text now always has a solid background so it cannot overlap other text.
🛠️ Settings sections (like Welcome & Leave) that showed a heading and nothing else now load. One broken setting can no longer blank a whole section.

entries.title: Sharper icons and tidier emails
entries.summary: Icons are now crisp at any text size, and update emails look right on phones.
items: 🎨 Every icon now has a circle-free twin that is used at text size, so small icons stay recognisable.
📱 Logos and shapes in Rex emails no longer get squashed on phones.

entries.title: Welcome guide
entries.summary: A full step-by-step guide with annotated pictures, from adding Rex to email settings and support.
items: 📖 New **/welcome** guide: adding Rex, the dashboard, tickets, premium codes, email preferences and how support reaches our staff, with a Jump to list.
owner_items: 📬 The owner inbox now shows emails exactly as sent, with folders, junk, trash and move.
🎟️ Emails can include a different premium code for every person.
🗑️ Premade update pages can be deleted from Owner tools.

entries.title: Applications page
entries.summary: Build application forms with questions, limits and accept/deny messages, then add them to any ticket panel.
items: 📝 The old Staff Applications tab is now **Applications**: build forms, set DM or website mode, questions with minimum length, accept/deny messages and a role.
🎟️ Ticket panels can use an **Application form** button.
⚠️ Picking a public channel as the mod log asks for confirmation.
🤖 New setting: Stop new bots on join (Protection & AutoMod).
fixes: Website applications now enforce the minimum answer length.

entries.title: Updates page
entries.summary: A new /updates page lists every new feature (kept for 30 days) with links to details, and the small fixes at the bottom.
items: 📰 New **/updates** page, linked in the menu and footer.
🧩 Premade, editable Updates and Bug fixes pages and emails live in their own group in the page and email builders.

entries.title: Smarter support helper
entries.summary: The support helper now knows every dashboard setting and page, the new applications and the bot gate.
items: 💬 About 6,000 more answers covering every setting and page.
🔎 Better matching for questions about applications and bots.
